consequence.statement: Environments that run image-automation-controller receive version v1.0.1 when upgrading to Flux 2.7.0; the release notes state no breakage, removed behaviour or required operator action for this update.
consequence.remediation: No action required; after upgrading to Flux 2.7.0, confirm the image-automation-controller pods roll out successfully on v1.0.1 and image automation policies still reconcile as expected.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 updates the image-automation-controller component image to v1.0.1; environments referencing that image are updated to the new version on upgrade, and the release notes state no required action.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: the evidence states only the new version (v1.0.1); the previous image-automation-controller version bundled before this release is not stated, so a before/after value-changed pair cannot be asserted
